sys_script.description:
When a Production Order is created or updated with a customer_order reference, resolves the customer's preferred delivery location using WarehouseRouter and sets it as the fulfillment_location.
IMPORTANT: This sets fulfillment_location (customer's delivery warehouse), NOT production_location. The three warehouses (Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai) are inventory-only and have no production machines. production_location is determined by the assigned production resource, not by the customer's choice.
Concept separation: fulfillment_location = WHERE the customer wants delivery (inventory warehouse) production_location = WHERE production machines are (production facility) assigned_resource = WHICH machine produces the order
Does NOT run if fulfillment_location is already set (respects manual overrides). Does NOT modify production_location, inventory, stock transfers, or resource allocation.
sys_script.name: Propagate Warehouse from Customer Order
